correctness.rationale: Reconstructed homogeneous normalization and exact total-minority drift u-u_next=(1-u)(2u²+B)/(2+2u-2u²-B); u decreases to 0. Bound u-u_next<=3u² yields non-summable u; subordinate max/min ratio decreases and must reach one, forcing B/u²->1/m. Reciprocal increment ->1+1/(2m), hence Cesaro gives all starting states exact t^-1 coefficients. For r>2 coordinate ratios contract by <=2/r and summable errors yield strictly positive geometric constants. Algebra for stationary q=(2-r)/(1+mr) and boundary m>=2 checked. Own independent unequal-start m=3 110000-step test t*u=0.853339 versus 6/7=0.857143 corroborates only; finite runs not the proof.
